cross_file_dependencies: R-prefixed ids resolve in V17_RECOVERY_PACKET_QUEUE.json. A split packet there is satisfied when its split_into packets are satisfied.

forward_compat_seams_from_v17.fence_reader_mapping: R27c/R28b: effects.begin_execution compares a mapping supplied by the owning module inside the transaction. 18-04 adds key site_epoch; no gateway reorder.
forward_compat_seams_from_v17.PolicyProvider.effective_scopes: R28b: scope intersection point. 19-03 adds the project extension grant; V30A-004 digests the same intersection.
forward_compat_seams_from_v17.AdapterRegistry: R28c: only registration path. 19-03 registers validated extension adapters; 23-09 packs reuse it.
forward_compat_seams_from_v17.AdapterManifest vocabulary: R29a: strict subset of ExtensionManifest, so a built-in integration is the smallest extension.
forward_compat_seams_from_v17.effect reservation `created` flag + CAS: R27b: lets 23-04 DispatchIntent treat an effect reservation as an idempotently compensable component.
forward_compat_seams_from_v17.unknown-effect path: R27e: reused by 18-07 restore reconciliation and the V2.0 response-loss drill.
forward_compat_seams_from_v17.KnowledgeService: R25a: 23-10 adds export/import here; V3 learning promotes knowledge only through accept_fact.
forward_compat_seams_from_v17.prove_defect: R02a: mandatory entry check for 19-07 and V3 controlled self-development.
